items.q: Who is eligible for the Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: Citizens of over 100 countries are eligible to apply for the Azerbaijan e-Visa online. Most European, North American, and Asian passport holders qualify.

items.q: How long does it take to get an Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: Standard processing takes 3 business days. Urgent processing delivers your approved e-Visa in just 3 hours for an additional fee.

items.q: How much does the Azerbaijan e-Visa cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on your nationality and chosen processing speed — see the country list above for exact fees.

items.q: How long can I stay in Azerbaijan with an e-Visa?
items.a: The Azerbaijan e-Visa allows a single entry with a maximum stay of 30 days, and is valid for 90 days from the date of issue.

items.q: What documents do I need to apply?
items.a: A valid passport with at least 6 months of validity, a digital passport-sized photo, a valid email address, and a payment card.

items.q: Can I extend my Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: The e-Visa cannot be extended online. To stay longer, apply for a new visa or contact the State Migration Service of Azerbaijan.

guide.title: Azerbaijan e-Visa — Complete Guide
guide.intro1: Azerbaijan offers an electronic visa (e-Visa) to citizens of over 100 countries, making it easier than ever to visit this remarkable country at the crossroads of Europe and Asia.
guide.intro2: The entire process takes just a few minutes — fill in your personal and passport details, select your visa type, pay the government fee online, and receive your approved visa by email within 3 hours (urgent) or 3 business days (standard). Your e-Visa is valid for 90 days from the date of issue, allowing a stay of up to 30 days.
guide.whyVisitText: Baku, the capital, blends ultramodern architecture with a UNESCO-listed Old City. The country offers stunning natural landscapes — from the Caucasus mountains to the Caspian Sea coast — rich history, and a rapidly growing tourism infrastructure.

country.needVisaTitle: Do {country} Citizens Need a Visa for Azerbaijan?
country.needVisaBody: Yes — {country} passport holders must obtain a visa before traveling to Azerbaijan. The good news is that {country} citizens are eligible for the Azerbaijan e-Visa, which can be obtained entirely online without visiting an embassy or consulate.

country.faqNeedVisaQ: Do {country} citizens need a visa for Azerbaijan?
country.faqNeedVisaA: Yes. {country} passport holders need a visa to enter Azerbaijan, but {country} citizens can apply for the Azerbaijan e-Visa entirely online — no embassy visit required.
country.faqTimeQ: How long does the Azerbaijan e-Visa take to process?
country.faqTimeA: Standard processing takes 3 business days. Urgent processing is available for an extra fee and is typically ready within 3 hours.
country.faqDocsQ: What documents do {country} citizens need to apply?
country.faqDocsA: A passport valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay, a digital passport-style photo, a valid email address, and a card for payment.
country.faqCostQ: How much does the Azerbaijan e-Visa cost for {country} citizens?
country.faqCostA: The current fee for {country} citizens is ${fee} USD, covering government and processing charges.
country.faqStayQ: How long can I stay in Azerbaijan on an e-Visa?
country.faqStayA: The e-Visa allows a single entry with a stay of up to 30 days, and is valid for 90 days from the date of issue.
country.faqExtendQ: Can I extend my Azerbaijan e-Visa?
country.faqExtendA: No, the e-Visa cannot be extended online. For a longer stay you'll need a new visa or to contact the State Migration Service of Azerbaijan directly.
